text:
maria: Starting a concise thread to land the long-term lane taxonomy + launch gates for routing, multi-region tenancy, and tenant isolation. Keep replies short.
kevin: Proposal: formal lane taxonomy (fast, balanced, green/cheap) + numeric gates. Fast: p99 <=110ms; Balanced: p99 <=250ms; Green: p99 <=600ms. Attach pricing multipliers per lane.
sanjay: For isolation modes name them: shared, soft-slice (namespaces + quota shapes), hard-slice (dedicated infra). I'll produce infra multipliers for small/med/large models.
lisa: Sales update: two large prospects require EU-only residency + dedicated model hosting + SOC2 audit logs. Mark as "privacy-first" must-haves.
noah: Draft policy DSL snippet for lane selection + failover: ```policy lane:fast select: region=eu,sla=low slo:p99<=110ms fallback:[fast-rr,balanced] canary:{pct:5 dur:10m}```
emma: Suggest an "isolation_index" (0-100) combining tail-variance, cache churn, and security constraints. Use index to auto-suggest lane and surface cost impact. Thresholds: 0-25 shared, 26-65 soft-slice, 66-100 hard-slice.
oliver: Ops: define an "eviction grace window" for migrations (prefill + parallel run) and billing reconciliation. Recommend default 12h, tunable per tenant. Also need a backfill automation to avoid cold-cache storms.
maria: Draft launch gates (v0): 1) lane SLA matrix documented + perf harness, 2) policy DSL implemented in staging with examples, 3) isolation_index computed for 3 pilot tenants, 4) migration playbook + billing rules for grace window, 5) enterprise acceptance checklist (residency/VPC/audit).
kevin: Add e2e chaos test that triggers fallback chain and verifies SLA preservation. I'll own.
sanjay: I'll include ops headcount uplift and runbook effort for soft vs hard slice.
lisa: I'll produce the customer-facing one-pager mapping asks -> acceptance language.
noah: I'll put a short RFC with multiple region-failover patterns and model-version fallback semantics.
emma: I'll prototype an isolation_index dashboard widget and run it on two pilot tenants by next Tue.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Lane taxonomy & pilot kickoff" Tue 09:00 Zoom.
maria: Thanks. I'll turn this into a PRD stub and assign owners. Keep follow-ups here.
